svg.text: FALSE case: one straight error wire, input tunnel → output tunnel, nothing else
ONE OUTPUT SQUARE, THREE DESTINATIONS. TCP Read’s error out feeds Clear Errors, Unbundle By
Name, and the VI’s own error out. That is legal because an error cluster being READ is data,
not a handle. Branching a refnum would be a bug; branching a cluster you only read is not.
Note what does NOT happen: Close File’s error out stops at the case output tunnel. It never
reaches the VI’s error out. The 56/66 the caller sees comes from branch B3, straight off TCP
Read — so a logging failure can never masquerade as a DUT failure.
Clear Errors sits on the path INTO the logger only. The log must be written even when the read
timed out — a timeout is exactly the row you most want in the trace file.
timeout ms was a constant until session 9. Making it a control moves the decision to the caller.
(terminates here — does NOT feed error out)
